hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just tidying the attic chamber, when I heard the sound of someone moving. Curious, I crept closer and found our new maid, Betty, in a state of undress. She was lacing her corset in the dim candlelight. I couldn't help but feel a flutter in my chest.
caption:
Curiosity led to a moment of tenderness.
